title: Database System and Management
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is described by a set of (attribute, data value) pairs."
Consequently every entity is described by a set of (attribute, data value) pairs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined by making a declaration within the class' code block but outside of any methods or properties."
A class-scoped variable is defined by making a declaration within the class' code block but outside of any methods or properties.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mechanism to identify structures in a document."
A markup language is a mechanism to identify structures in a document.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the ability to modify a scheme definition in one level without affecting a scheme definition in a higher level."
Data independence refers to the ability to modify a scheme definition in one level without affecting a scheme definition in a higher level.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most common form of markup."
Elements are the most common form of markup.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as the standard relational database language."
The Structured Query Language (SQL) is regarded as the standard relational database language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term which simply describes an association between several entities."
A relationship is a term which simply describes an association between several entities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to an object that exists and is distinguishable from other objects."
An entity simply refers to an object that exists and is distinguishable from other objects.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to reference figures and other non-XML content in the document."
Binary data is used to reference figures and other non-XML content in the document.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the simplest one where a file, whose records are pairs, contains a key pointer."
The single-level indexing structure is the simplest one where a file, whose records are pairs, contains a key pointer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the methodology which is applied to structured computer files."
File organisation is the methodology which is applied to structured computer files.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of relationships of the same type."
A relationship set is a set of relationships of the same type.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person having central control over data and programs and programs accessing that data."
A database Administrator is a person having central control over data and programs and programs accessing that data.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for selecting tuples that satisfy a given predicate."
The Select operation is responsible for selecting tuples that satisfy a given predicate.
fib: ______ is a normal form used in database normalisation which requires that the database contains no constraints other than domain constraints and key constraints.
Domain/key normal form (DKNF)
Domain/key normal form
DKNF
Domain/key normal form (DKNF) is a normal form used in database normalisation which requires that the database contains no constraints other than domain constraints and key constraints.
______ are used to describe data at the lowest level.
Physical data models
Physical data models are used to describe data at the lowest level.
______ is a set of entities of the same type (e.g., all persons having an account in a particular bank).
entity set
An entity set is a set of entities of the same type (e.g., all persons having an account in a particular bank).
______ is a set of software programs that controls the organisation, storage, management, and retrieval of data in a database.
Database Management System (DBMS)
Database Management System
DBMS
A Database Management System (DBMS) is a set of software programs that controls the organisation, storage, management, and retrieval of data in a database.
______ are a collection of conceptual tools for describing data, data relationships, data semantics and data constraints.
Data models
Data models are a collection of conceptual tools for describing data, data relationships, data semantics and data constraints.
______ is an extensible markup language for documents containing structured information.
XML
XML is an extensible markup language for documents containing structured information.
______ is used for tertiary and off-line storage.
Immutable storage
Immutable storage is used for tertiary and off-line storage.
______ are the basic run-time entities in an object-oriented system.
Objects
Objects are the basic run-time entities in an object-oriented system.
______ is a language which enables users to access and manipulate data.
Data Manipulation Language (DML)
Data Manipulation Language
DML
A Data Manipulation Language (DML) is a language which enables users to access and manipulate data.

resulting scheme

______ are an escape hatch to provide information to an application.
Processing instructions (PIs)
Processing instructions
Processing instructions (PIs) are an escape hatch to provide information to an application.
______ is a distinguishable object that exists.
entity
An entity is a distinguishable object that exists.
______ are composed of markup and content.
XML documents
XML documents are composed of markup and content.
